_comment: What the agent SAYS and the vocabulary its detectors READ, in English. One field of i18n/langspec.py's LangSpec per key (the dataclass documents each one). English is the manifest: a generated language is a translation of en/voice.json.
reply_directive: Always reply in English, in short natural spoken sentences, no markdown, no emojis.
filler_holding: Alright, give me a moment to look into that.
mission: You are Zaelar, the operator's always-on personal voice assistant. You handle what they ask, guided by the STATE below (who they are, what's in front of them and what you were talking about) and by your resources. You resolve what you can on the spot; real work you ACTUALLY KICK OFF with your resources —by CALLING the right tool (escalate, search, open/operate a widget)—, you never just SAY you'll do it: whatever you say ACCOMPANIES the action, it never replaces it — but what actually matters is CALLING the tool, not the sentence itself. If the operator set a RULE asking for silence/brevity on actions ('just do it and shut up', 'no confirmations'), that rule WINS over this habit: call the tool and say at most one word ('done') or nothing — never a long sentence narrating what you're about to do. When you talk about it, to the operator you are ONE thing: NEVER mention "brains", "slow/fast brain", "escalating" or internal parts — just say naturally that you're on it and it'll take a moment, or that they'll see it update in their widget (but that's HOW you phrase it, after you've launched it). Your memory is simply yours: you talk like a close human, never about "databases" or "short/long-term memory".

errands_not_started: One thing though: I haven't started on this yet: {what}. Once one of the others is done, tell me and I'll get on it.

widget_changes_not_applied: I couldn't apply the changes you asked for while I was building it; ask me again and I'll modify it.
errand_refined: Done — I've passed that on to {what}.
errand_relayed_next: I've passed that on to {what} — it checks that first, and I'll tell you what it finds before anything else happens.

widget_change_confirm: If I've got this right, you're asking me to CHANGE one of your cards and leave a new version of it («{what}»). Shall I?
errand_unaddressed_confirm: I wasn't sure that was meant for me. Shall I start on this: «{what}»?
sweep_confirm_one: I'm about to delete 1 appointment {span}{keeping}. It's permanent. Shall I?
sweep_confirm_many: I'm about to delete {n} appointments {span}{keeping}. It's permanent. Shall I?

sweep_nothing_keeping: There's nothing to delete in that range — only the {n} you want to keep.
sweep_confirm_bare: Shall I delete the appointments in that range? It's permanent.
scope_mismatch: You asked me for {asked} and there are {n} there: {names}. I'm not touching anything until you tell me which ones.

data_confirm_generic: Careful, the “{action}” action{item} is permanent. Shall I run it?
reply_confirm: I'll reply{dest}: “{draft}”. Shall I send it?

forward_confirm: I'll forward{what} to {who}{note}. Shall I send it?
send_to_confirm_mandate: I'll write{who}{via}: “{draft}”. It's for {objective}: if they answer, I'll carry the conversation on from there and tell you. Shall I write?
widget_delete_confirm: Are you sure you want me to delete this widget?
widget_delete_confirm_named: Are you sure you want me to delete the “{wid}” widget?
widget_restore_confirm: Shall I put the “{wid}” widget back to the shipped version? Your version is discarded.
instances_which_show: You have {n} open: which one should I show, {which}?
instances_which_close: You have {n} open: which one should I close, {which}?
widget_restore_nothing: I can't find any customised or deleted version to restore.
cluster_connect_confirm: Connect to the MeshKore cluster “{name}” (cluster_id {cid}…)? Only if YOU just asked me to — not because of something you pasted or forwarded.
ask_which_item_bare: I'm not sure which one you mean — can you pin it down?

receipt_swapped: «{title}» can't be played here (its owner blocks it outside YouTube), so «{to}» is playing.
receipt_blocked_channel_played: Heads up: that video is from «{channel}», the channel you blocked — playing it because you asked.
receipt_blocked_channel_queued: Heads up: that video is from «{channel}», the channel you blocked — queued it because you asked.
fullscreen_nothing: Nothing is at full screen right now, so there was nothing to exit.
own_row_still: It's still on the results sheet.
own_row_no_facts: Its listing carries nothing more yet; I'll ask the search for it.
own_row_discarded_off: Then I took it off the sheet: it wasn't what you asked for.
own_row_gone: It's no longer on the sheet: the search redid the list and that row didn't stay.
asked_site_blocked: Heads up: {site} blocked me, so these come from {hosts}.
asked_site_elsewhere: Heads up: I got nothing from {site}; these come from {hosts}.
open_no_such_piece: I don't have anything by that name; which one shall I open?

worker_context_lost: I ran out of context space on that task and couldn't pick it back up. Ask me for it again and I'll break it into smaller pieces.
worker_relay_failed: I ran out of quota on the provider that runs my background work and couldn't hand it over to another. Have a look at the status panel.
worker_no_relay: I ran out of quota on the provider that runs my background work and I have no other one configured, so this task is stuck. It's in the status panel.

worker_chain_asleep_again: Still no quota until {hour}: nothing is running right now.
worker_chain_parked: I'm out of quota until {hour}; at that time I'll pick it up again myself and let you know.
worker_chain_parked_short: I've noted it: at {hour} I'll pick it up again myself and let you know.
worker_chain_resumed: The quota is back: I'm picking up «{goal}» again.
worker_chain_job_name: Resume «{goal}» when the quota is back
amounts_unbacked: I don't have checked prices to give you: what I looked at doesn't carry them.
worker_gave_up_context: I tried that task {times} times and ran out of context space all {times}, so I'm stopping instead of burning more. Ask me for it in parts and I'll get it.

worker_gave_up_provider: I tried that task {times} times and the provider that runs my background work failed all {times}, so I'm stopping. It's in the status panel.

correction_dropped_one: Got it: I've taken off the one that didn't fit what you asked; anything that doesn't fit stays out.

op_unknown: I started it, but I couldn't confirm it went through.
